name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=dialog/UI frame, descriptor=assemble_dialog_frame_layered). 'layered' accurately denotes the layered draw order: corners drawn first to anchor the frame, then stretchable edges, then inner fill. No address residue. Verb (assemble) + object (dialog_frame) accurately reflect that it composes a tiled dialog box. keep.
purpose: Compose a resizable dialog box at an arbitrary (n_cols, n_rows) tile size by blitting 17 sprite tiles from the UI/anim sprite sheet in a layered order (corners, then stretchable edges, then a repeated interior fill).
logic_summary: Computes topleft = dst + col_offset + row_offset*pitch (pitch=byte row stride; tiles are 0x10 px). Blits 8 corner tiles first to anchor the frame: outer top 1/2, outer bottom 3/4 at bottom_full=row_pixels_16*n_rows, inner top 5/6, inner bottom 7/8, mid-row edges E/F, and bottom-row secondary corners 10/11 at row_pixels_16*(n_rows-1). Then loops the top inner edge (sprite 9) and bottom inner edge (sprite C) across n_cols-2 columns; loops left edge (sprite A) and right edge (sprite B) down n_rows-2 rows; finally double-loops the center fill (sprite D) over the full n_cols x n_rows interior. Each tile blit calls fd2_blit_sheet_sprite_at_offset(dst_addr, pitch, sheet_ptr, sprite_idx).
signature: void fd2_assemble_dialog_frame_layered(uint32 dst, uint32 pitch, uint32 col_offset, int row_offset, int n_cols, int n_rows)

params.name: dst
params.semantics: Destination framebuffer base address (e.g. 0xA0000 for VGA mode 13h, or an off-screen 320x200 composite buffer). Confirmed by disasm [ESP+0x34] added into topleft and by callers passing 0xa0000 / composed_target_buf.
params.reason: Accurate, conventional name for the output buffer base; no address residue.

params.name: pitch
params.semantics: Byte row stride of the destination (0x140 = 320 in all callers). Used as the SHL/IMUL base for row offsets and passed as the 2nd arg to every fd2_blit_sheet_sprite_at_offset call (disasm ESI = [ESP+0x38]).
params.reason: Standard graphics term for the row stride; matches usage exactly.

params.name: col_offset
params.semantics: Horizontal byte offset of the dialog top-left within the destination row (5 in all callers). Added directly into topleft (disasm EBP = [ESP+0x3c]).
params.reason: Accurately describes the horizontal placement offset; no address residue.

params.name: row_offset
params.semantics: Vertical placement in rows; multiplied by pitch to compute the top-left row (disasm [ESP+0x40] IMUL ESI=pitch). Callers pass 'flip'/0x70 etc.
params.reason: Accurately describes the vertical placement (in rows); no address residue.

params.name: n_cols
params.semantics: Dialog width in tile-cells. Drives n_cols_minus_2 (top/bottom edge run length, disasm [ESP+0x44]-2) and the inner-fill column loop bound.
params.reason: Clear cell-count name matching the width dimension; no address residue.

params.name: n_rows
params.semantics: Dialog height in tile-cells. Drives bottom_full (=row_pixels_16*n_rows for sprites 3/4), bottom_row_ofs (=row_pixels_16*(n_rows-1) for 10/11), the left/right edge run length (n_rows-2), and the inner-fill row loop bound (disasm [ESP+0x48]).
params.reason: Clear cell-count name matching the height dimension; no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; effect is the composed dialog frame written into the destination buffer.
